sentence: I wake up at seven o'clock
explanation: El patrón básico es Sujeto + Verbo + Tiempo: <I wake up at seven o'clock>.

sentence: She brushes her teeth every morning
explanation: Sigue el patrón Sujeto + Verbo + Objeto + Expresión de tiempo.

sentence: He takes a shower before breakfast
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + Verbo + Objeto + Tiempo: <He takes a shower before breakfast>.

sentence: We have lunch at twelve thirty
explanation: Las comidas siguen el patrón: Sujeto + have + comida + at + hora.

sentence: They go to school by bus
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + go to + lugar + by + medio de transporte.

sentence: I get dressed after my shower
explanation: <Get dressed> es un phrasal verb que significa vestirse.

sentence: She reads a book before bed
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + Verbo + Objeto + Tiempo: <She reads a book before bed>.

sentence: He walks to work every day
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + Verbo + to + lugar + frecuencia.

sentence: We eat dinner at seven in the evening
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + eat + comida + at + hora + in the + parte del día.

sentence: I go to bed at ten o'clock
explanation: Decimos <go to bed> (sin artículo) cuando hablamos de ir a dormir.

sentence: She makes breakfast for her family
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + Verbo + Objeto + for + persona.

sentence: He does his homework after school
explanation: El patrón es Sujeto + do + posesivo + homework + hora.
